evidence:
Source-consistency Pass: no drift found in the row-49 fact inventory. Paths below are relative to the frozen task unless a run artifact is named. instruction.md:9 and environment/instructions/integration.md:3-10 agree on Node 22, /app/server.js, port 3000, /api/health, /app/app.db and DB_PATH. solution/solve.sh:3-6,35 copies the co-located app to /app; server.js:2 loads src/index.js, whose main thread delegates to bootstrap.js. bootstrap.js:18-23 handles health without DB work, :43 binds 0.0.0.0 using PORT or 3000. Its worker uses an internal ephemeral port, not an alternative public port. db.js:13-15 resolves DB_PATH and its bundled seed relative to the module; index.js:37 resolves static UI relative to the module. Public runtime-copy/CWD/sanitized-env allowance in hireops_rules.md:415-420 matches test.sh:97-111 and :160-167. Restart substitutions preserve the same APP_ENTRY/APP_DB; test.sh:193 exports APP_RESTART_HELPER, functional/judge.toml's verifier MCP consumes exactly $APP_RESTART_HELPER, and functional/prompt.md:3,53 calls restart_app once. restart_mcp.py:14,29-40 implements that tool and its single-use marker.

The two seed files are byte-identical SHA256 1b39015461a7a4f23b835aeea9584caffd0266c64d394778376cbd6c8a18bcf7. seed_data.json:3, hireops_rules.md:59-60 and app_context.md:23 agree on 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z; db.js:127-133 stores it and rules.js:17-21,142-149 uses it for referrals. Effective-date rescission and original-anchor calendar arithmetic agree between the rules, rules.js:23-47,105-138, functional P4/P7/P8/B6 and the criteria. All seven email/role/tier identities agree between instruction.md:13, seed users, app_context.md:8-16 and functional permission rows; Hireops!2026 agrees with db.js:126. The three referrers and the 4-year annualization, 200000/350000 dollar band boundaries, 12-month signing/equity cliffs (40%/+5% and 20%/+4%), and 10000-dollar 50/50 referral split agree with seed constants and criteria. I independently recomputed P3 boundary examples, all A/B/C P4 economics, B1 netted-cycle amounts, and odd-unit/odd-cent retained amounts; source-audit.json records the checks.

task.toml:30-36 exactly preserves the template verifier environment (claude-code, z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx, OpenRouter variables); all five judge fallbacks match. Both Dockerfiles and package.json agree on Express 5.1.0 and better-sqlite3 12.4.1. All prompt URLs are localhost:3000 and test.sh probes the equivalent IPv4 loopback. scoring.toml:1-11 is the sole dimension-share policy (zero-weight gates; .6/.2/.2; functional floor .05) and tools/score.py:10,29-48 resolves and consumes it. Six shared runtime files match the frozen template byte-for-byte. Actual criteria counts are render 1, constraints 1, functional 145, polish 5, visual 5 (157 total); task metadata makes no stale count claim. The configured-parser raw result reports these same counts and judge settings, with no unresolved placeholders.

Evidence binding: independently verified all 428 entries and every matching_source_files binding in raw-evidence-index.json SHA256 3f80963d8840e21b11d9ae1f7778681dbffb7260f3d15aaddcdb66848a15a561, with zero mismatches. Also compared every tests_sha256 in local/configured-inspection/results.json (68a8e192fc287fa192052ca0c74eccdcda93ba0d28f440641f0ef8337825db57) and every solution_app_sha256 in local/install-lifecycle/results.json (125aa681a04307790302ad83f62dec1db084392d8dee6519346cb57c31ed8dee) directly to frozen bytes. The read driver and raw lifecycle result establish a sanitized unprivileged launch from /tests and actual shared-MCP restart PID 21 to 97 retaining the saved requisition; the restart log shows port 3000. The parser driver substitutes /usr/bin/true for the constructed command's executable and therefore establishes argument acceptance only, not provider grading.

Risk remains true for missing required task-level runtime measurements: full configured judge workload/grading, actual-app reward discrimination/ranking, Oracle/target scores and hosted/private-checker evidence are not supplied. The source-consistency pass does not waive those gaps, infer a score, or equate a scripted golden/CLI-parser run with full judge execution. No new Docker/provider run was performed for this row.
counterexample: Broken alternative considered: an otherwise polished app that derives referral vesting from the wall clock, or resets DB state during restart. Fixed seed/reference values, functional P8/hro_referral_clock and P10/hro_restart would expose these; no conflicting alternate clock/seed instruction gives them a source-contract escape. A balance-only freshness implementation is also inconsistent with public section 11 and B2/hro_change_aba; the indexed finite scripted witness fails with 200 instead of required 409 (not a configured reward result). Conforming alternative considered: an initially empty operational desk with supplied users/referrers/constants, generated IDs and different routes. instruction.md:11, app_context.md:21-27 and functional P1/P9 explicitly allow it; the indexed empty_operational_seed scripted variant completes all 15 recorded groups. No conflicting mandatory import count, fixed private route or ID format was found. Ordinary local source inspection, not an empirical judge score, supports the row verdict.
